tagline: Slide the tiles together until one of them is 2048.
summary: 2048 is Gabriele Cirulli's sliding-tile puzzle from 2014. Every move pushes all tiles as far as they go; two tiles with the same number that touch merge into one, doubling it, and a new 2 or 4 appears after every move.
Reach the 2048 tile to win — then keep going for a higher score. The game is over when the board is full and no two neighbours can merge.

This is the original game, ported to TypeScript with its rules, its 4×4 board, its colours and its animations. The best score and a running game are kept in the player's account on the server; the original kept them in the browser.

controls.input: Arrow keys, W A S D or H J K L
controls.action: Move the tiles up, right, down or left (a move that changes nothing spawns no tile)
Move the tiles on a touch screen
Keep going after the 2048 tile; try again after game over
